lines.en: label ayanespring3:
scene black
After the last bell has rung and the doors have been opened...
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet1
: Meeting — start! Attendance will now be taken. Makoto!
: Present.
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet2
: Wonderful. That concludes the taking of attendance. We may now proceed with the matters at hand.
: Which are...what, exactly?
: Oh, you know. Assorted apocalypse stuff. What we’re going to wear for the next reset. How I’m your new best friend. Things like that.
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet3
: Okay, but you’re going to have to be the one to break the news to Miku.
: Losing me leaves her with either Kirin, Io, or my mom as her new best friend. And I’m sure you can see the negative impact any of them would have on her.
: Isn’t Miku becoming a little sex gremlin thing now? Wouldn’t that mean that you have also had a negative impact on her?
: Yes. It is my fault. Not the fault of the adult man who claimed her virginity with the same amount of thought he’d put into redeeming a 500 yen scratch off ticket.
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet4
: Is all that stuff I've been hearing about him breaking her vagina really true?
: No comment.
: Not even a little comment? A tiny one? You really won’t spare any details for your new best friend?
: Sorry — where is this sudden interest in Miku’s vagina coming from? Is there something you’re not telling me, Ayane?
: No, but there’s something you’re not telling me.
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet5
: I am willing to look past that if it brings us closer together, though.
: It won’t, but okay.
: Vaginas aside! It’s time to continue planning our escape from this mortal coil. And seeing as I have so far been the idea girl, I am now passing the torch to you.
: Wait, me?
: Yes. You. Who else am I going to pass it to?
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet6
: Well, for one, Yumi still exists. Which you may or may not have forgotten based on the fact that you didn’t invite her to our meeting.
: Yumi doesn’t want to be involved in any of the apocalypse stuff, though.
: And I do? Correct me if I’m wrong, but I’m pretty sure I have verbally stated on several occasions now that things are better for me here. Why would I want to get out of this timeloop?
: It’s less that you’d want to get out and more the fact that you’re the type of person who habitually solves problems. And what bigger problem is there than this?
: Oh, okay. So you’re just taking advantage of my intellect then.
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet7
: Right.
: And you have no shame regarding this at all.
: Nope. Not even a little. So, what’s your plan?
: I don’t have one.
: Buuuut, if you were to come up with one, what would it be?
: I’m not asking you to figure out time travel in one sitting. I just want something to run with and build off of.
: And I’ve had my hands too full with my own misery lately to be able to come up with anything worth trying.
: Well, we could maybe start by finding you a therapist.
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet8
: Denied. I am formally requesting a new idea.
: And I am formally requesting that you take my legs off of your lap. How did you get there so quickly?
: Doesn’t matter. What does matter is that we create a comfortable environment for one another. And sometimes, mild physical touch can help with that!
: Or, and hear me out here, make everything way less comfortable.
: Jeez, Makoto. You’d think for someone who’s had a foot-long cock inside of her over a thousand times that you’d be more open to putting your legs on someone’s lap.
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet9
: Sorry, do you have a foot-long cock you’ve just never told me about?
: Maybe. Would you think any less of me if I did? And be careful with your answer, Makoto. It’s Pride month.
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet10
: Okay, you want an idea? Here. I think we should start taking Yumi’s position in our team a little more seriously, whether she wants to be included or not.
: You think she’ll actually go along with it?
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet11
: I think she doesn’t have much of a choice. What’s the worst thing that could happen? She says no and we just stay the same way we’ve been since I got thrown into this?
: The worst thing that can happen is that she beats you up. And I wouldn’t be able to live with myself if I put you in danger, Makoto.
: Thank you, but I think I’ll be fine.
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet12
: Don’t you think Yumi’s seemed a little off lately though?
: Because she’s...actually coming to school? And participating in stuff like the Dorm Wars?
: Yeah, exactly. Doesn’t that make you think something might be going on with her?
: Could that “something” not just be resignation? Like, maybe she’s accepted this situation already and figures there’s no point in just waiting for it to blow over anymore?
: I’d agree under normal circumstances. But something about the way she’s been carrying herself lately makes me feel like she’s more sad than anything.
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet13
: Can Yumi even feel such an emotion?
: Of course. Everybody gets sad, Makoto. I’m sure you’ve had a good cry in the bathroom at least once over your time here.
: Yeah. My dad just needed to die for it.
: Then I am sorry for making you think about that again. But the fact remains, Yumi seems like she’s not in the sort of mindset we need to make any sort of progress right now.
: And what sort of mindset is that, Ayane? Because I was under the impression we just never made any progress here.
: Sure we do. You and Yumi even being able to talk about this is progress. And I’m sure Maya and Sensei would have said the same thing about me when I joined.
: Yeah, where is he? Shouldn’t he be here too?
: Probably. In regard to the mindset thing, though, I feel like you and I are the only ones normal enough to figure anything out at the moment.
: I think you’re gravely overestimating just how much two teenagers can accomplish in the field of metaphysics.
: Sure. But people would say the same about our ability to receive Sensei’s penis and here we are. Just two penis experts hanging out on a couch.
: Ayane — my idea is simple. We let time run its course and just carry on the same ways we would if we were not involved in a timeloop.
: Trying to interfere with any of it will likely just confuse us more or, even worse, fuck something up. Is that really something we want to risk?
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet14
: Hah...no. It’s just that “letting time run its course” is exactly what Maya did. And if she were here today, she’d be jumping at every single opportunity to actually do something.
: Just...she is here today. And you’re more than welcome to try talking to her about any of this if you want. I’m sure the old her would have approved of that too.
: I have been trying. It’s just...
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet15
: It...hurts.
: Sensei’s not the only one affected by her disappearance. And being able to experience this with her, like...formed a bond that felt...really special to me.
: Well...I’m sorry I’m not her. And I’m sorry I’m not approaching things the way she would.
: But she is still here. So there has to be something the two of you can-
: She’s weird too, though. And lately, I...
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet16
: You what? What is that expression?
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet17
: Just...out of curiosity...have you noticed anything odd about the way she’s been with Ami lately?
: I feel like we’re at a point in this timeline where every single interaction with Ami is going to be “weird” in some way or another.
: Well, yes. But I can’t help but feel like the two of them are hiding something from me. From everyone. And neither one of them will clue me in on it.
: Hmm...maybe they’ve started a second “Love Squad” specific to only those with A-cups?
: Or maybe they just don’t trust me the way they used to...
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet18
: Well, you did lose the Maya you apparently had a “special bond” with. So I imagine this one wouldn’t just inherently trust you right off the bat.
: Right, I get that. And I wouldn’t expect that either. But it’s like...
: I can hang out with Ami and everything will be normal. I can talk to Maya and everything will be “normal.”
: But when the two of them are together, it always feels like I’m being left out of something.
: And I don’t know...maybe it’s just karma for Maya and I making Ami feel that way before everything happened. But maybe it’s more?
: What would “more” even be, though? It’s not like they’re secretly having sex behind closed doors or anything.
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet19
: That’s the part I can’t figure out. And any time I try to probe Ami for answers, she just gaslights me into thinking everything’s completely normal.
: Well, that’s no surprise at all given her relationship with Sensei and how she likely does the same with him.
: If I were you, I wouldn’t be probing her at all. I’d be trying to figure things out from Maya instead. At least she can likely be annoyed into submission.
: My relationship with Ami is different, though. She and I have always been really close. She’s basically my little sister.
: Or...maybe she just wants you to think you’re really close and the reality is that she’d stab you in the back at any moment if it meant getting closer to what she really wants?
: She can’t, though.
: What do you mean she “can’t?”
: I mean she literally can’t. My guardian angel told me as much.
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet20
: Your what?
: You wouldn’t get it. In fact, I don’t really get it. But questioning seemingly paranormal entities here has never led me to any good, so I just listen to them now.
: Ayane, if Big Boi has been secretly visiting you at night, you should probably let me know.
: It’s not Big Boi, I swear.
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet21
: I wonder how he’s doing, though.
: Yeah. He kind of just showed up that one time and then disappeared forever.
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet22
: Oh. Hi, Imani.
: Guys, I know it’s Pride month, but if the two of you are going to do lesbian stuff together, you should at least do it in the dorms.
: We’re not doing lesbian stuff, though. We’re having a meeting.
: A meeting that requires Makoto’s legs in your lap?
: For what it’s worth, I also told her this was not conducive to a proper setting for a meeting.
: The hell are you two having a “meeting” for anyway? School ended an hour ago. Shouldn’t you be out having fun and being social and shit?
: Me, probably. Makoto, not so much.
: Yeah, I wasn’t really talking about her.
: I let you use my office and this is how you repay me?
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet23
: It ain’t your office, ho! This place belongs to Sensei! And now that he ain’t here, it probably belongs to me!
: I’ve been here longer! I have seniority!
: I’m your senior! Which should literally imply that I have seniority!
: And I’m Sensei’s wife, which means that half of this office belongs to me.
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet24
: Lies! I’m definitely the closest to being his actual wife! But I will not reveal how or why!
: Fine, Mrs. Ayane Arakawa. Compromise reached. But I get the half with the desk because I have papers to grade and doing it on the floor of my apartment hurts my back.
scene black
: Ooh! Can I get extra credit if I help?
: Sure. You don’t really need it, though.
: Can I help too or will grades not go higher than 100%%?
: You can give your extra credit to Miku. Lord knows she needs it.
: Ugh. Fine.
: See? This is what I was talking about. You always have to help. It’s in your DNA.
: Cool! You two handle these then and I’ll go home early. But remember — no lesbian stuff!
: Miss Imai-
: Hah. Okay, fine. You can do a little lesbian stuff. But only because it’s Pride month. Above the clothes only. Got it?
: Wha-
: Got it! Thanks, Imani! Love you!
: Love you too! See you both on Monday!
: We’re not lesbians!
: Can’t hear you! Too busy being an ally!
$ ayanespring3 = True
Ayane and Makoto’s affection for one another has increased by 1!
They swear it’s not because of gay stuff, though.
